selection_population: first eight validation recordings; no fresh/provisional test data
visual_gate: Fixed frame grids must show useful changes and no new geometry defects; near-identity outputs do not establish useful refinement.
one_optional_followup: If corrections consistently point toward the target but sampled residuals add error, test a fixed antithetic pair (+noise and -noise), averaged after denoising, to cancel first-order sampling variation without shrinking all corrections. No further training.
confirmation: Use remaining three validation recordings only if a candidate passes the quantitative and visual gates. They remain validation, not final test.
stop: No meaningful multi-recording gain, quality loss, or 45 minute ceiling.
